title: Sukhdev Singh v. Bhagatram Sardar Singh Raghuvanshi

content.caseIdentity: Sukhdev Singh v. Bhagatram Sardar Singh Raghuvanshi, (1975) 1 SCC 421
content.facts: The status of statutory corporations and their employees under Article 12 was considered.
questionsBeforeCourt: When can statutory corporations be treated as instrumentalities of the State?
content.ratioDecidendi: Statutory corporations exercising public functions may fall within the constitutional conception of State and are subject to fundamental-rights constraints.
content.holding: The Court treated the named statutory corporations as State instrumentalities.
content.relevance: Use for constitutional status of public corporations.
